ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Medicaid operator's bankruptcy-to-riches rise
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud against a Minnesota Medicaid operator and its sudden change in fortune.
questions: What are the allegations against the Medicaid operator?

ideas.insight: The investigation should focus on the operator's financial records and interviews with key individuals involved.
